market_question: Will Liverpool finish in the top 4 of the EPL 2025–26 standings?
reasoning: Liverpool are on course for a dominant 2024-25 title under Arne Slot, with a deep squad and elite key players. A 75% probability of a top-4 finish is conservative, making the market's 52.5% price a clear value opportunity on Yes.
